items: New versions download in the background and ask to restart.
Imports use the newest patch instead of the whole-season average.
Every champion, the live patch, D+/D- tiers and the real game count.
Pick the splash arts you like; blur and darkness are adjustable.
The onetricks header is the title bar and stays on top while scrolling.
Profiles and matches load in parallel.
Only one OTP rune page is kept; old ones are removed.
Ad and tracking requests are blocked.
